segments.an5.54:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu jiṇṇo hoti jarāyābhibhūto.
segments.an5.54:2.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu byādhito hoti byādhinābhibhūto.
segments.an5.54:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, dubbhikkhaṃ hoti dussassaṃ dullabhapiṇḍaṃ, na sukaraṃ uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ.
segments.an5.54:4.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhayaṃ hoti aṭavisaṅkopo, cakkasamārūḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti.
segments.an5.54:5.2: Saṅghe kho pana, bhikkhave, bhinne aññamaññaṃ akkosā ca honti, aññamaññaṃ paribhāsā ca honti, aññamaññaṃ parikkhepā ca honti, aññamaññaṃ pariccajā ca honti.
segments.an5.54:5.3: Tattha appasannā ceva nappasīdanti, pasannānañca ekaccānaṃ aññathattaṃ hoti.
segments.an5.54:5.5: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca asamayā padhānāyāti.
segments.an5.54:6.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu daharo hoti yuvā susu kāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā.
segments.an5.54:7.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu appābādho hoti appātaṅko, samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya.
segments.an5.54:8.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, subhikkhaṃ hoti susassaṃ sulabhapiṇḍaṃ, sukaraṃ uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ.
segments.an5.54:9.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, manussā samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti.
segments.an5.54:10.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, saṅgho samaggo sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharati.
segments.an5.54:10.2: Saṅghe kho pana, bhikkhave, samagge na ceva aññamaññaṃ akkosā honti, na ca aññamaññaṃ paribhāsā honti, na ca aññamaññaṃ parikkhepā honti, na ca aññamaññaṃ pariccajā honti.
segments.an5.54:10.3: Tattha appasannā ceva pasīdanti, pasannānañca bhiyyobhāvo [bhīyyobhāvāya (ka.)] hoti.
segments.an5.54:10.5: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca samayā padhānāyā”ti.

lines: Na sukaraṃ uñchena paggahena yāpetunti na sakkā hoti pattaṃ gahetvā uñchācariyāya yāpetuṃ.
Tatiye padahatīti padahano, bhāvanamanuyutto yogī, tassa bhāvo bhāvanānuyogo padahanabhāvo.
Padhānamassa atthīti padhāniko, ka-kārassa ya-kāraṃ katvā “padhāniyo”ti vuttaṃ.
“Abhinīhārato paṭṭhāya āgatattā”ti vuttattā paccekabodhisattasāvakabodhisattānampi paṇidhānato pabhuti āgatasaddhā āgamanasaddā eva, ukkaṭṭhaniddesena pana “sabbaññubodhisattāna”nti vuttaṃ.
Adhigamato samudāgatattā aggamaggaphalasampayuttā cāpi adhigamasaddhā nāma, yā sotāpannassa aṅgabhāvena vuttā.
Yathā tena paṭividdhena sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ hatthagataṃ ahosi, tathā paṭividdhaṃ.
Yassa buddhasubuddhatāya saddhā acalā asampavedhi, tassa dhammasudhammatāya saṅghasuppaṭipannatāya tena paṭivedhena saddhā na tathāti aṭṭhānametaṃ anavakāso.
“yo, bhikkhave, buddhe pasanno dhamme pasanno saṅghe pasanno”tiādi.
Padhānavīriyaṃ ijjhati “addhā imāya paṭipadāya jarāmaraṇato muccissāmī”ti sakkaccaṃ padahanato.
Daḷhaṃ katvā pacantī hi gahaṇī ghorabhāvena pittavikārādivasena rogaṃ janeti, sithilaṃ katvā pacantī mandabhāvena vātavikārādivasena tenāha “nātisītāya nāccuṇhāyā”ti.
Gahaṇitejassa mandapaṭutāvasena sattānaṃ yathākkamaṃ sītuṇhasahatāti āha “atisītalaggahaṇiko”tiādi.
Yāthāvato accayadesanā attano āvikaraṇaṃ nāmāti āha “yathābhūtaṃ attano aguṇaṃ pakāsetā”ti.
Udayatthagāminiyāti saṅkhārānaṃ udayañca vayañca paṭivijjhantiyāti ayamettha atthoti āha “udayañcā”tiādi.
Tassa dukkhassa khayagāminiyāti yaṃ dukkhaṃ imasmiṃ ñāṇe anadhigate pavattirahaṃ, adhigate na pavatti, taṃ sandhāya vadati.
